name: Model side, any disagreement
frozen_rule: Bet the side the model favours whenever sign(model_margin) != sign(market_spread) and |residual| >= 0.5 points. No filter. Price: the two-sided spread price in the corpus, de-vigged.
what_would_change_our_mind: A certified strategy must show positive Brier skill vs the close on the holdout AND a positive residual alpha whose interval excludes zero. Seeing either fail in the opposite direction (negative skill with an interval above zero) is what would change the verdict to 'worse than the market'
